description: Defines a structure for managing multiple PCAP (Packet Capture) objects and their signal handlers, and provides a factory function to create and initialize these PCAPs for O-RAN CU-CP components.

classes.name: ocudu::o_cu_cp_dlt_pcaps
classes.description: Structure managing multiple PCAP objects and their signal handlers for O-RAN CU-CP.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes (and flushes) all PCAPs without destroying the objects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Destroys (closes and flushes) all PCAPs and their signal handlers.
